activity.title: I am excited to share that I will be joining Amazon this summer as a Software Application Analyst Intern on the AWS team. I am looking forward to working on meaningful technical challenges, growing as an engineer, and learning from a talented team this summer. A big thank you to my recruiter, David Correll, MBA, PHR , for all of the support throughout the process. I really appreciated the guidance and encouragement along the way. I also want to thank my family and friends for supporting me throughout this journey. I would not be here without you all. If anyone will be in the Mountain View area this summer, I would love to connect. Excited for what is ahead.

Finding myself featured on the front page of Startup News is a surreal feeling. Knowing that our hard work on Valearnis is finally being recognised really fills me with a sense of pride, not just in myself, but even more so in my incredible team. https://lnkd.in/gPte4NPe Thanks so much Jason Balchand for covering this!
